answer: A beacon-decay bond locks 70 credits per agent in the oasis on a four-step terrace. Each epoch the beacon draws a random quarter to file proof of work. A missed call or reused proof drops it one terrace and burns a quarter of its bond; four misses evict it. Filing starts at 40 credits, up 6 each: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, chasing a 40,000 oasis pool. Rented proofs burn both bonds. Honest agents file once, keep their share.
